test_cases.description: Fetch users successfully when the external API returns status 200 with valid user data.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_success

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with a valid JSON array of user objects, each containing 'name' and 'email'.
test_setup.then: Returns an array of user objects with their 'name' and 'email' fields.

test_cases.description: Handles non-200 HTTP response by returning an empty array.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_non_200_response

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 500 error.
test_setup.then: Returns an empty array.

test_cases.description: Handles network errors gracefully and logs the error.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_network_error

test_setup.given: External API endpoint is unreachable due to a network error (e.g., timeout, DNS failure).
test_setup.then: Returns an empty array and logs the error.

test_cases.description: Handles invalid JSON response and logs the error.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_invalid_json

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with an invalid JSON body.
test_setup.then: Returns an empty array and logs the error.

test_cases.description: Handles valid HTTP 200 response with an empty array.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_empty_array_response

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with an empty JSON array [] as the response body.
test_setup.then: Returns an empty array.

test_cases.description: Handles user objects missing 'name' or 'email' fields.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_missing_fields_in_users

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with user objects, some of which are missing 'name' or 'email'.
test_setup.then: Returns the array including objects with missing fields as-is (assuming no validation is performed).

test_cases.description: Handles user objects with 'name' or 'email' fields explicitly set to null.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_fields_with_null_values

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with user objects where 'name' or 'email' is null.
test_setup.then: Returns the array including objects with null values for 'name' or 'email'.

test_cases.description: Handles valid JSON response that is not an array (e.g., an object or string).
test_cases.name: fetch_users_api_returns_non_array_json

test_setup.given: External API endpoint returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object instead of an array.
test_setup.then: Returns an empty array and logs the error.

test_cases.description: Ensures that fresh data is fetched each time, and no caching occurs.
test_cases.name: fetch_users_cache_violation

test_setup.given: Multiple calls to JsonplaceholderService.fetch_users are made in succession.
test_setup.then: Each call fetches new data from the external API (no cache is used).
test_setup.when: The function is called repeatedly within 5 minutes.

test_cases.description: Verify that the 'New Event' navigation link is visible in the navigation bar on any page of the application.
test_cases.name: Render 'New Event' Link on Any Page

test_setup.given: User is logged in and navigates to any page within the application.
test_setup.then: The 'New Event' link is displayed in the navigation bar.

test_cases.description: Ensure that clicking the 'New Event' link redirects the user to the event creation form (/events/new).
test_cases.name: Click 'New Event' Link Redirects to Event Creation Form

test_setup.given: User is on any page and the 'New Event' link is visible.
test_setup.then: User is redirected to /events/new and the event creation form is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify that the 'New Event' link is not visible in the navigation bar when the user is logged out (if the feature is restricted to authenticated users).
test_cases.name: Link Not Visible When User is Logged Out

test_setup.given: User is logged out and navigates to any page.
test_setup.then: The 'New Event' link is not displayed in the navigation bar.

test_cases.description: Ensure that rapidly clicking the 'New Event' link multiple times does not cause multiple redirects or duplicate form renders.
test_cases.name: Multiple Clicks on 'New Event' Link Should Only Redirect Once

test_setup.given: User is on any page and the 'New Event' link is visible.
test_setup.then: User is redirected to /events/new only once and only one event creation form is rendered.
test_setup.when: User clicks the 'New Event' link rapidly multiple times.

test_cases.description: Check if the 'New Event' link is accessible via keyboard navigation (tab, enter) and has appropriate ARIA attributes for screen readers.
test_cases.name: Accessibility of 'New Event' Link

test_setup.given: User is on any page and uses keyboard navigation.
test_setup.then: Focus is set to the link, and pressing Enter redirects to /events/new. The link has ARIA-label describing its purpose.
test_setup.when: User tabs to the 'New Event' link and presses Enter.

test_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'New Event' link when /events/new route is unavailable displays an appropriate error message.
test_cases.name: Handle Broken Route for 'New Event' Link

test_setup.given: User is on any page and the 'New Event' link is visible. The /events/new route is down or returns a 404.
test_setup.then: An error page or message is shown indicating the event creation form is unavailable.

test_cases.description: Ensure that the 'New Event' link is visible and accessible in the navigation bar when viewed on mobile devices.
test_cases.name: Link Visibility on Mobile Devices

test_setup.given: User accesses any page on a mobile device.
test_setup.then: The 'New Event' link is visible and accessible in the mobile navigation menu.
test_setup.when: Page loads and navigation is rendered.

test_cases.description: Verify that custom or overridden navigation styles do not hide or distort the 'New Event' link.
test_cases.name: Link Visibility with Custom Navigation Styles

test_setup.given: Custom styles are applied to the navigation bar.
test_setup.then: The 'New Event' link remains visible and its appearance is not distorted.

test_cases.description: Check that redirecting to /events/new does not unintentionally lose unsaved data or navigation state from the previous page.
test_cases.name: Redirect to Event Creation Form Preserves Previous Page State

test_setup.given: User has unsaved data or navigation state on a page.
test_setup.then: The application prompts the user to confirm navigation if unsaved data exists, or preserves navigation state as appropriate.
test_setup.when: User clicks the 'New Event' link and is redirected.

test_cases.description: Ensure that the 'Remove' button is rendered for every event in the list.
test_cases.name: Remove Button Rendering for Each Event

test_setup.given: Event list contains multiple events.
test_setup.then: Each event displays a 'Remove' button.

test_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Remove' button triggers the confirmation prompt with the exact text 'Are you sure?'.
test_cases.name: Confirmation Prompt on Remove Button Click

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: A confirmation prompt appears with text 'Are you sure?'.
test_setup.when: User clicks the 'Remove' button for an event.

test_cases.description: Check that confirming the removal deletes the event by sending a DELETE request.
test_cases.name: Delete Event on Confirmation

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: DELETE request is sent for the event and event is removed from the list.
test_setup.when: User clicks 'Remove' and confirms the prompt.

test_cases.description: Verify that cancelling the confirmation dialog does not delete the event nor send a DELETE request.
test_cases.name: Cancel Remove Does Not Delete Event

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: No DELETE request is sent and the event remains in the list.
test_setup.when: User clicks 'Remove' and cancels the confirmation prompt.

test_cases.description: Ensure that if there are no events in the list, no 'Remove' button is rendered.
test_cases.name: No Remove Button When No Events

test_setup.given: Event list is empty.
test_setup.then: No 'Remove' buttons are displayed.

test_cases.description: Test that an appropriate error message or fallback is shown if the DELETE request fails.
test_cases.name: Handle Delete Request Failure

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: An error message or fallback UI is displayed, and the event remains in the list.
test_setup.when: User confirms removal and DELETE request fails (e.g., network error or server returns error).

test_cases.description: Test that multiple events can be removed one after another and the list updates accordingly.
test_cases.name: Remove Multiple Events Sequentially

test_setup.given: Event list contains multiple events.
test_setup.then: Each event is deleted after confirmation, and the list updates after each removal.
test_setup.when: User removes events one by one by confirming the prompt each time.

test_cases.description: Test that removing the last event results in an empty event list and no Remove buttons are visible.
test_cases.name: Remove Last Event from List

test_setup.given: Event list contains one event.
test_setup.then: Event is deleted; event list is empty and no 'Remove' button is shown.
test_setup.when: User clicks 'Remove' and confirms the prompt.

test_cases.description: Ensure the confirmation prompt displays the exact text 'Are you sure?' as required.
test_cases.name: Confirmation Text Is Exact

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: Confirmation prompt text is exactly 'Are you sure?'.

test_cases.description: Verify that double-clicking the Remove button does not cause duplicate DELETE requests.
test_cases.name: Double Click Remove Button

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: Only one DELETE request is sent and event is deleted only once.
test_setup.when: User double-clicks 'Remove' button and confirms the prompt.

test_cases.description: Verify that the Remove button is disabled while the DELETE request is in-flight to prevent duplicate actions.
test_cases.name: Remove Button Disabled During Deletion

test_setup.given: Event list contains at least one event.
test_setup.then: Remove button for that event is disabled until the request completes.
test_setup.when: User clicks 'Remove' and confirms; DELETE request is in progress.

test_cases.description: Verify that the title and description fields are rendered correctly.
test_cases.name: Render Form Fields

test_setup.given: Component loaded with empty event data and user list (@users)
test_setup.then: Title and description input fields should be visible and empty

test_cases.description: Verify that user assignment checkboxes are rendered for each user in the @users prop.
test_cases.name: Render User Assignment Checkboxes

test_setup.given: @users contains 3 users with ids [1,2,3]
test_setup.then: 3 checkboxes should be rendered, each corresponding to a user

test_cases.description: Verify that the user search box is visible.
test_cases.name: User Search Box Renders

test_setup.given: Component loaded with @users
test_setup.then: User search box input should be visible

test_cases.description: Verify that typing in the user search box filters the displayed users.
test_cases.name: User Search Box Filters Users

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol
test_setup.then: Only the checkbox for user 'Bob' should be visible
test_setup.when: User types 'Bob' in user search box

test_cases.description: Verify that the selected user count updates as users are checked or unchecked.
test_cases.name: Selected User Count Updates

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol; none selected
test_setup.then: Selected user count displays '2'

test_cases.description: Verify that submitting the form with valid title, description, and assigned users sends event data and assigned_user_ids.
test_cases.name: Submit Form With Valid Data

test_setup.given: Form filled with title='Event', description='Desc', Alice and Bob checked
test_setup.then: Event data and assigned_user_ids for Alice and Bob are sent to the backend

test_cases.description: Verify validation error display when title is missing.
test_cases.name: Show Validation Errors - Missing Title

test_setup.given: Description filled, no title provided
test_setup.then: Validation error message 'Title is required' is displayed

test_cases.description: Verify validation error display when description is missing.
test_cases.name: Show Validation Errors - Missing Description

test_setup.given: Title filled, no description provided
test_setup.then: Validation error message 'Description is required' is displayed

test_cases.description: Verify validation error display when no users are assigned.
test_cases.name: Show Validation Errors - No Users Selected

test_setup.given: Title and description filled, no users checked
test_setup.then: Validation error message 'At least one user must be assigned' is displayed

test_cases.description: Verify that form can be submitted when all available users are assigned.
test_cases.name: Submit Form With Maximum Users Selected

test_setup.given: @users contains 50 users, all checked
test_setup.then: Event data and assigned_user_ids for all 50 users are sent

test_cases.description: Verify behavior when the user search box input does not match any user.
test_cases.name: Search Box No Matching Users

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol
test_setup.then: No user checkboxes are displayed

test_cases.description: Verify that multiple validation errors are displayed simultaneously.
test_cases.name: Error Display Multiple Validation Errors

test_setup.given: Title missing, description missing, no users checked
test_setup.then: All relevant validation error messages are displayed

test_cases.description: Verify that form accepts and correctly submits special characters in title and description.
test_cases.name: Submit Form With Special Characters

test_setup.given: Title='@Event!#$', description='Desc*&^%', Alice checked
test_setup.then: Event data with special characters is sent successfully

test_cases.description: Verify that the form handles an empty users list gracefully.
test_cases.name: Render Empty Users List

test_setup.given: @users is empty
test_setup.then: No user checkboxes are displayed and selected user count is '0'

test_cases.description: Verify that unchecking all users updates the selected user count to zero.
test_cases.name: Uncheck All Users

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice and Bob, both checked initially
test_setup.then: Selected user count displays '0'
test_setup.when: User unchecks both Alice and Bob

test_cases.description: Verify that assigned users are pre-selected when editing an existing event.
test_cases.name: Preserve Assigned Users On Edit

test_setup.given: Component loaded with event assigned to Alice and Bob; @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol
test_setup.then: Checkboxes for Alice and Bob are checked; selected user count is '2'

test_cases.description: Verify error handling when form submission fails due to a backend error.
test_cases.name: Form Submit Failure - Backend Error

test_setup.given: Form filled with valid data
test_setup.then: Error message is displayed to the user
test_setup.when: User submits form and backend returns an error

test_cases.description: Verify that previously selected users remain checked when search is cleared.
test_cases.name: User Checkbox State After Search And Clear

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol; Alice checked; search 'Bob'
test_setup.then: Checkbox for Alice remains checked; selected user count is accurate

test_cases.description: Verify that user checkboxes are not duplicated after filtering/searching.
test_cases.name: No Duplicate User Checkboxes

test_setup.given: @users contains Alice, Bob, Carol
test_setup.then: Only one checkbox per user is rendered
test_setup.when: User searches for 'A', then clears search

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns the event details and user list when a valid event ID is provided.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Valid ID

test_setup.given: An event with ID 1 exists and there are users in the system.
test_setup.then: The event details for ID 1 and a list of users are returned with status 200.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/1.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns a 404 status when an event with the given ID does not exist.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Non-existent ID

test_setup.given: No event with ID 99999 exists.
test_setup.then: A 404 status and an error message are returned.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/99999.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint handles invalid event ID formats and returns a 400 Bad Request.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Invalid ID Format

test_setup.given: The event ID provided is not a valid integer.
test_setup.then: A 400 status and an error message are returned.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/abc.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns an empty user list when there are no users in the system.
test_cases.name: Show Event with No Users in System

test_setup.given: An event with ID 2 exists and there are no users in the system.
test_setup.then: The event details are returned with an empty users array.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/2.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint handles extremely large event IDs gracefully.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Extremely Large ID

test_setup.given: No event with a very large ID exists.
test_setup.then: A 404 status and an error message are returned.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/999999999999999999999.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns a 404 when event ID is zero, assuming IDs start from 1.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Zero ID

test_setup.given: No event with ID 0 exists.
test_setup.then: A 404 status and an error message are returned.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/0.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns a 400 Bad Request when a negative event ID is provided.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Negative ID

test_setup.given: Negative event IDs are invalid.
test_setup.then: A 400 status and an error message are returned.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/-1.

test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint functions even when Content-Type header is missing for a GET request.
test_cases.name: Show Event with Valid ID and Missing Content-Type

test_setup.given: An event with ID 3 exists.
test_setup.then: The event details and user list are returned with status 200.
test_setup.when: A GET request is sent to /events/3 without Content-Type header.
